lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce3Ag2 (Ce12Ag8 per cell) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 20 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 11 neighbors (2 Ag, 9 Ce), while Ce environments include 14 neighbors (2 Ag, 12 Ce) and a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner, edge, and face contacts between 11-vertex Ag and 14-vertex Ce coordination polyhedra, and corner and face sharing among 11-vertex Ag polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites.
